subject.statement: Jeremy Jordan-Jones (CEO of Amalgam Capital Ventures)

summary: VERDICT: ADVERSE (97% confidence). Jeremy Jordan-Jones, CEO and one-third shareholder of Amalgam Capital Ventures, was charged by the SEC on 2025-05-21 and indicted by the DOJ for wire fraud and false statements after mid‑2025, establishing adverse legal findings as of 2026-10-01.

findings.statement: Jeremy Jordan-Jones is the CEO and one-third shareholder of Amalgam Capital Ventures.
As of 2026-09-30, Jeremy Jordan-Jones remained the CEO of Amalgam Capital Ventures.
On May 21, 2025, the Securities and Exchange Commission charged Jeremy Jordan-Jones with securities violations.
The Department of Justice indicted Jeremy Jordan-Jones for wire fraud and false statements related to defrauding investors in Amalgam Ventures (charges unsealed after mid-2025).

conflict_notes: The SEC complaint (weight 0.95) describes Jeremy Jordan-Jones as the current CEO and one‑third shareholder of Amalgam Capital Ventures, whereas a Crunchbase entry (weight 0.40) labels him the "former" CEO. The higher‑weight SEC source was given precedence, leading to the conclusion that he remained CEO as of the filing date.
